newsitem.title: USA: Old America Stores files for Chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: Old America Stores files for Chapter 11.

text.p: Old America Stores Inc said on Monday that it filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection, and that its reorganization plans include reviewing unprofitable stores and its merchandise mix.
Old America said in a news release that it has closed 16 stores in the past six weeks and is considering more closures before the end of 1997.
The company also said it has reduced corporate staff by 20 percent.
Old America said it has obtained debtor-in-possession financing, increasing its overall facility to $35 million from $30 million.
Old America said it will conduct business as usual during its reorganization. The company said it believes its vendors will support it after the filing.
